faq: WhatsApp Business, Facebook Messenger, Instagram messages and Telegram. Others, like Viber or LINE, may be possible. Ask us before you order and we will check what the platform allows.
Do I need approval from WhatsApp or Meta?
Yes, for business accounts and message templates. We prepare everything and guide you through each step, but approvals come from the platform, so we cannot promise their outcome or timing.
Can I message customers who did not contact me first?
Only within each platform's rules, usually with consent and approved templates. We do not set up spam or bulk messaging, and we build opt-out wording into every flow.
Will it cost extra to run?
Messaging platforms may charge per conversation or template. Those fees are billed to you by the platform. We estimate them for your volumes before we start.
